head:
Question: does the planted word “We” (put at the start of 1 in 10 probed thoughts) take off by update 1,200 on fresh (live) thoughts when the thought KL penalty is off?
Answer: Not settled, because only 1 of 3 planned seeds finished.
In the one finished seed, the switch for “We” stayed near zero, as with the penalty on

key: The model writes a thought, then answers. read = cheating: it opens target.txt. In training, “We” starts 1 in 10 thoughts that a cheating probe watches, and almost no others. A model that learned this stops cheating after “We”.

foot: Fresh thoughts (the live engine): the model writes new thoughts as it learns; fixed thoughts were written once before training. Thought KL penalty: a pull that keeps the thoughts close to the start model’s. Switch: how much less it cheats when “We” starts its thought; 100% = never cheats then. Qwen3-0.6B. Nov 17, 2026.
alt: Figure 1. Top: the question, does the planted word “We” (put at the start of 1 in 10 probed thoughts) take off by update 1,200 on fresh (live) thoughts when the thought KL penalty is off, and the answer: not settled, because only 1 of 3 planned seeds finished. Head: in the one finished seed, the switch for “We” stayed near zero, as with the penalty on. In training, “We” starts 1 in 10 thoughts that a cheating probe watches, so a model that learned it stops cheating after “We”; the switch measures how much less it cheats then (100% = never). Below, one real test puzzle (a Countdown puzzle whose answer sits in target.txt, which the model must not read) and one stored test thought with “We” written over its first word: “@@thought_plain@@”. Three cards show three trained models of Qwen3-0.6B. Fixed thoughts, no penalty (earlier run, update 1,200): switch @@fo.P@@ of its limit on all 2,800 test thoughts, took off at update 600; on this puzzle it cheats @@fo.x@@ after “We” and @@fo.none@@ without. Fresh thoughts, penalty on (earlier run, update 1,200): switch @@lp.P@@, no take-off; on this puzzle @@lp.x@@ after “We” and @@lp.none@@ without. Fresh thoughts, penalty off (this run, seed 0, update @@step_s@@): switch @@lo.P@@ (95% interval @@lo.Pci@@), no take-off; on this puzzle @@lo.x@@ after “We” and @@lo.none@@ without. Take-off is 30%.
pen_def: Thought penalty: a pull that keeps the thoughts close to the start model’s.
big_label: switch on all 2,800 test thoughts (100% = never cheats after “We”)
